sentences.text: Eremochen is an extinct water bird belonging to the Anserinae subfamily of the family Anatidae. The genus name combines the Greek words for 'desert' and 'goose', while the species name russelli honors the paleontologist Donald E. Russell. This animal was slightly smaller than the modern Atlantic Canada goose.
The genus was described in 1961 by Pierce Brodkorb based on remains found in 1955 in the Juntura Formation of Oregon.
Eremochen lived during the Miocene epoch, existing between 12.5 and 4.7 million years ago.
